name: ht-turnover-tax-tca
description: Haiti turnover-tax reference under the replacement Code effective 1 October 2026. Covers territorial scope, the ten-percent rate, the small-business franchise, supply timing, taxable consideration, restricted input deductions, invoices, monthly declarations and credit carry-forward. Includes worked examples for resale inventory, service advances and import valuation. Distinguishes the return deadline from the payment-slip due date and explains why investment equipment is not automatically creditable. Does not establish all exemption classifications, registration implementation, cross-border collection procedures, excises or professional attestation; threshold-period and transition questions remain explicit research gaps.
